usage_scenarios.rate_unit: FIELD PEAS AND CANOLA: The only oil recommended for use with Daredevil 520 Herbicide is Uptake\* Spraying Oil. Daredevil 520 Herbicide + Lontrel 750 SG + Uptake\* Spraying Oil are compatible and selective to canola. This tank-mix is also compatible with atrazine and selective to triazine tolerant canola.

usage_scenarios.rate_unit: LUPINS AND FIELD PEAS: Mixtures with Brodal or simazine may cause crop yellowing and separate applications are recommended.
usage_scenarios.rate_full_text: LUPINS AND FIELD PEAS: Mixtures with Brodal or simazine may cause crop yellowing and separate applications are recommended.

usage_scenarios.rate_unit: CHICKPEAS, FABA BEANS, LENTILS AND VETCH, LINOLA, LINSEED: Broadleaf herbicides should not be added to Daredevil 520 Herbicide. Apply Daredevil 520 Herbicide and broadleaf herbicides at least a week apart.
usage_scenarios.rate_full_text: CHICKPEAS, FABA BEANS, LENTILS AND VETCH, LINOLA, LINSEED: Broadleaf herbicides should not be added to Daredevil 520 Herbicide. Apply Daredevil 520 Herbicide and broadleaf herbicides at least a week apart.

constraints.description: LUCERNE, CLOVER OR MEDIC PASTURES: If grazed or cut for hay immediately prior to treatment delay application until all grasses have fully expanded leaves. Use 75 mL + spraying oil or 100 mL + wetter/ha. (See GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS, Spraying Oils/wetters section).
If silver grass (Vulpia spp.) is present in pasture, simazine should be tank mixed with the higher rate of Daredevil 520 Herbicide plus a non-ionic wetter.
